Politics · India

US-India ties at 30-year low due to Trump policies, claims US lawmaker

Indian-American Congressman Ro Khanna stated that US-India relations have reached their lowest point in 30 years, attributing this decline to former President Trump's policies. Khanna claimed India's ambassador to China conveyed that a generation of trust was lost. However, a US envoy and other commentators have disputed this assessment, asserting that India-US ties remain strong and that Trump's visits were successful.
